issues.description: Q7 distractors (risky, uncertain, nervous) are all obviously negative while the blank requires a positive word. Q15 (다의어 face) is marked as 어려움 but the noun vs verb distinction is relatively straightforward for most students. The (A) context (washed her face) is unambiguous. Not a blocking issue.

Q1-3 (ABC type): correct words appear elsewhere in the fullPassage since this is a short single-passage text. This is inherent to the format and flagged by validator as B-level EX-3 warning. Not fixable without changing the passage.

verdict: PASS - No HIGH severity issues. 4 LOW/INFO observations noted. All questions are solvable with clear single answers.
